author: Brinegs
quote:
Biggest let down in video game history, and I remember when ET came out for Atari. 

In this game you will: 
Go shopping at the grocery store, item by item. 
Feng shui your apartment to make it female likable. I’m not kidding. 
You get to go get clothes for your girlfriend. 
You get to build a coffee table with her in real time complete with the allen key. 
You get to paint the bedroom for her, with a roller, swipe by swipe, and it’s not a short process. 
You get to repair the roof, shingle by shingle and nail each shingle down one by one. 
You get to have hours, and I really do mean hours of endless conversation with her where all you to do is talk because you’re in a relationship. 
You get to take her dancing. 
You get to buy her jewelry. 
You get to open a bank account together where you actually go into the bank and talk to the manager to open your join bank account. 
And if you thought that wasn’t enough, you also have the opportunity to fix your ex-girlfriend sink because it’s clogged up. Yeah, you go unclog her sink… no pun intended. 
And the cherry on top of the cake is you get to meditate with your girlfriend. In real time. Breathing in and breathing out for a very long time.. Yep, in this game, you actually practice breathing. SO painful. 


This is a romance novel. Nothing to do with ANYTHING GTA. 

I don’t mind them turning a romance novel into a game, but why in the world did they have to call it grand theft auto? 

Don’t waste your money. You will regret it.
